library(tidyverse)

genes <- paste("gene", 1:1000, sep="")


x <- list(A = sample(genes,300),
          B = sample(genes,525),
          C = sample(genes,440),
          D = sample(genes, 50))

ggVennDiagram::ggVennDiagram(x = x)

layer_data(i = 1) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x,y, group = group, fill = fill) + 
  geom_polygon()

Experiment

gene_data <- tribble(~A, ~B, ~C,
                      T, T, F, 
                      T, T, T,
                      T, F, T)

library(tidyverse)

df_conditions_inclusion_list <- function(df){

  conditions <- df |> names()
  
  conditions
  
  out <- list()

  for(i in 1:length(conditions)){

    out[[i]] <- which(df[conditions[i]] |> pull())

  }

  out
}




compute_panel_venn <- function(data, scales){
  
df <- data |> 
  df_conditions_inclusion_list() |>
  Venn() |> 
  process_data(shape_id = NULL) 
  

left_join(ggVennDiagram:::get_shape_regionedge(df),
            ggVennDiagram:::venn_region(df)) |> 
  rename(x = X,
         y = Y,
         group = id)

}



compute_panel_venn_label <- function(data, scales){
  
df <- data |> 
  df_conditions_inclusion_list() |>  ## dims go here
  Venn() |> 
  process_data(shape_id = NULL) 
  

left_join(ggVennDiagram:::get_shape_regionedge(df),
            ggVennDiagram:::venn_regionlabel(df)) |> 
  rename(x = X,
         y = Y,
         group = id)

}


gene_data |> 
  compute_panel_venn() |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x, y, group = group) + 
  geom_point()
## Joining with `by = join_by(id)`

gene_data |> 
  compute_panel_venn() |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x,y, group = group, fill = group) + 
  geom_polygon()
